title: RDK-B Core Broadband Regional Applicability
description: Per-profile, per-region radio/power configuration and regulatory compliance status. Sibling file to memory-footprint/flash-layout/cpu-utilization, kept separate from hw-compat.schema.json so regional and certification status can change independently on their own timeline without touching the core spec. Core RDK-B defines the platform capability layer (see Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 9); actual certification is an OEM/operator product-program responsibility, so 'status' must never be marked certified/production-qualified without real evidence.

profileId.description: Matches the profileId in the corresponding hw-compat.schema.json file for this profile.

regionName.description: Optional. Human-readable region name, e.g. "North America (US)".

regulatoryDomain.description: Primary regulatory scheme/authority for this region, e.g. "FCC", "ISED", "RED", "MTCTE", "ANATEL", "KC", "RCM".

radios.description: Regional radio band/power configuration. Not a substitute for certification evidence — describes what the platform is configured to do in this region.

dfsRequired.description: True if Dynamic Frequency Selection is required for available channels in this region.

operatingModes.description: Regional 6 GHz operating modes: Low Power Indoor, Very Low Power, Standard Power (typically requires AFC).

afcRequired.description: True if Automated Frequency Coordination is required for Standard Power operation in this region.

compliance.description: One entry per applicable regulatory scheme for this region.

status.description: Must not be 'certified' without a certificateId or equivalent evidence reference.

certificateId.description: Certificate or test-report identifier. Required to be non-null when status is 'certified'.

notes.description: Optional. Free-text notes on regional status or open items.
